content.short: Grid, DCA, futures grid and arbitrage bots come free inside Pionex, a crypto exchange built around automated trading.
content.description: Pionex makes automated trading its main feature. Instead of connecting a third-party bot to an exchange, users run grid, DCA, futures grid, rebalancing and arbitrage bots inside Pionex at no extra cost, and they trade around the clock. Grid bots, which buy as price falls and sell as it rises within a range, are the best known. Users can check that their balances are fully backed through a Merkle-tree reserves report. It calls itself the first exchange with trading bots built in, and adds structured earn products, stock and precious metal tokens, and a meme token discovery tool.
